document: British Columbia Provincial Polling: Week of October 14 (Vancouver Sun, 2024-10-18)
note: Final Leger poll before the 2024-10-19 election. Online panel, n=1,017; decided voters (incl. leaners and those who had already voted) weighted n=861, unweighted n=859. Shares among decided voters from the 'Provincial voting intentions x region' chart (p. 8, column 'Oct 15 2024'); national NDP/CON/GRN from p. 3; national Other (3%) is not printed in the release and is taken from the Wikipedia table (equals the residual). BC United had withdrawn; no BCU option. Regional bases not published. Region labels verbatim: Metro Van, Van Island, Rest of BC (coded INTERIOR-NORTH).
